configurePresets.name: intel-llvm
configurePresets.description: Vendor-neutral clang++ -fsycl from the intel/llvm nightly bundle, C++17. Primary supported toolchain.

configurePresets.name: adaptivecpp
configurePresets.description: AdaptiveCpp acpp driver, C++17. Secondary vendor-neutral toolchain.

configurePresets.name: oneapi
configurePresets.description: Intel oneAPI DPC++ (icx-cl) with vcpkg, C++17. Supported path for VTune/Advisor profiling. Relies on VCPKG_ROOT and the oneAPI setvars environment.

environment._comment: Run oneAPI setvars.bat (or source setvars.sh) before configuring so CMPLR_ROOT/PATH/INCLUDE/LIB are populated. The build no longer hardcodes the oneAPI install path.
